load_vizwiz_dataset: load the VizWiz dataset from an annotation JSON file for visual question answering
create_vizwiz_dataset_instance: create a VizWiz dataset instance with a data root, image prefix, and annotation file
filter_answerable_questions: filter VizWiz annotations to include only answerable questions with confident answers
compute_answer_weights: compute answer weights by counting unique answers and dividing by total answer count
register_vizwiz_in_mmpretrain: register the VizWiz dataset class in the mmpretrain DATASETS registry for use in training pipelines
